title: The Stop hook's unpushed-commits nudge skips a branch whose head is already on origin/main
why: Lane artifact-pages-other-account (session_013NEJL49cWWQx8kXJAVpNoi), 04:38 CST Nov 9: after #2360 merged and runner 8 deleted the branch, the local branch had fast-forwarded to main. Stop hook command 9 counted 502 unpushed commits, all main's, and told the lane to push. The push recreated `artifact-pages-other-account` on origin as a plain copy of main (triage read: tip 81a720c42, an ancestor of origin/main). A nudge that recreates a deleted branch undoes the cleanup.
note: Fix proposed by the lane: skip a branch whose head is already on origin/main. The stray branch is on step branch-cleanup's delete list. Filed 04:39 CST Nov 9. Lane session_013NEJKz3J95T7tJBtSYUXZ9 started 12:13 CST Nov 9 (coordinator).
